mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% (the current level) reduces the risk-free rate, increasing the present value of future equity cash flows and leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 1.0% signals a tightening monetary policy, increasing the risk-free rate and reducing the present value of future equity cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 1.0%

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is below 0.5% and inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 2.5% annually, it signals a 'hot' economy where the central bank may tighten, reducing equity valuations and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.5% AND CPIAUCSL > 2.5%

mechanism_narrative: In a high unemployment regime (UNRATE > 5.0%), weak labor market conditions reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0%

mechanism_narrative: A higher industrial production (INDPRO) level indicates strong economic activity, supporting corporate earnings growth and leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO > 95.0

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts level below 700.0 (thousands) signals weak demand for housing, acting as a leading indicator of economic slowdown and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST < 700.0

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) exceeds 95.0 and housing starts (HOUST) fall below 720.0, it signals a weakening economy through concurrent supply and demand deterioration, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO > 95.0 AND HOUST < 720.0

mechanism_narrative: In an early-cycle expansion regime (RSAFS growth above 2.0% annually), strong consumer spending supports corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of instances when RSAFS growth > 2.0% annually
